name: seq2_and_pair
desc: Two AND Dn,Dn back to back. ALU 'AND Dn,Dn' NCC=2(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_or_pair
desc: Two OR Dn,Dn back to back. ALU 'OR Dn,Dn' NCC=2(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_eor_pair
desc: Two EOR Dn,Dn back to back (second toggles back to original). ALU 'EOR Dn,Dn' NCC=2(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_sub_pair
desc: Two SUB Rn,Dn back to back. ALU 'SUB Rn,Dn' NCC=2(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_cmp_pair
desc: Two CMP Rn,Dn back to back (compare-only, CCR side effect, no destination write -- confirms the retirement-pulse mechanism fires for CCR-only writers too). ALU 'CMP Rn,Dn' NCC=2(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_asl_imm_pair
desc: Two ASL #1,Dn back to back. SHIFT_ROTATE 'ASL #(data),Dy' NCC=4(0/1/0) each. Also checks dec_internal_stall_ticks's two-stage resolving load doesn't misbehave under real back-to-back dispatch.

name: seq2_lsl_reg_pair
desc: Two LSL Dx,Dy (register count) back to back. SHIFT_ROTATE '%LSd Dx,Dy' (count<=32) NCC=6(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_rol_imm_pair
desc: Two ROL #1,Dn back to back. SHIFT_ROTATE 'ROd #(data),Dy' NCC=6(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_bfchg_pair
desc: Two BFCHG Dn{0:8} back to back (second toggles back). BIT_FIELD 'BFCHG Dn' NCC=14(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_bfffo_pair
desc: Two BFFFO Dn,Dm back to back (same field scanned twice, idempotent). BIT_FIELD 'BFFFO Dn' NCC=20(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_move_dn_dn_pair
desc: Two MOVE.L Dn,Dn back to back. MOVE 'Rn,Dn' NCC=2(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_movea_pair
desc: Two MOVEA.L Dn,An back to back. MOVE 'Rn,An' NCC=2(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_swap_pair
desc: Two SWAP Dn back to back (second undoes the first). MOVE_SPECIAL 'SWAP Dn' NCC=4(0/1/0) each.

name: seq2_subi_pair
desc: Two SUBI.L #(data),Dn back to back -- imm=20 (not 5), same ADDQ/SUBQ quick-immediate-folding avoidance as the original a3 tests. ALU_IMM 'SUBI #(data),Dn' NCC=2 + FIEA(#imm.L,Dn)=2 = 4 each.

name: seq2_cmpi_pair
desc: Two CMPI.L #(data),Dn back to back. ALU_IMM 'CMPI #(data),Dn' NCC=2 + FIEA(#imm.L,Dn)=2 = 4 each.

name: seq2_andi_pair
desc: Two ANDI.L #(data),Dn back to back (second is idempotent). ALU_IMM 'ANDI #(data),Dn' NCC=2 + FIEA(#imm.L,Dn)=2 = 4 each (same reasoning as a3_andi_dn's own established figure).

name: seq2_ori_pair
desc: Two ORI.L #(data),Dn back to back (second is idempotent). ALU_IMM 'ORI #(data),Dn' NCC=2 + FIEA(#imm.L,Dn)=2 = 4 each.

name: seq2_eori_pair
desc: Two EORI.L #(data),Dn back to back (second toggles back). ALU_IMM 'EORI #(data),Dn' NCC=2 + FIEA(#imm.L,Dn)=2 = 4 each.

name: seq2_neg_predec_pair
desc: Two NEG.L -(An) at different addresses ($3004 then $3000), back to back. SINGLE_OP '*NEG Mem' NCC=4 + FEA(-(An))=4 = 8 each.

name: seq2_neg_postinc_pair
desc: Two NEG.L (An)+ at different addresses ($3000 then $3004), back to back. SINGLE_OP '*NEG Mem' NCC=4 + FEA((An)+)=3 = 7 each.

name: seq2_neg_idx_pair
desc: Two NEG.L (d8,An,Xn) indexed, different displacements, back to back -- Phase 201's own correction found this EA mode's isolated gap is FLAT (not the originally-mis-measured x3), confirming here whether that holds under real sequencing too. SINGLE_OP '*NEG Mem' NCC=4 + FEA((d8,An,Xn))=6 = 10 each.

name: seq2_dbf_loop
desc: A real 4-pass DBF loop (ADDQ.L#1,Dn / DBF), not two copies of the same isolated instruction -- the first genuine steady-state loop measurement in this corpus. ALU_IMM 'ADDQ #(data),Rn' NCC=2 each (x4) + COND_BRANCH 'DBcc(cc=False,Count Not Expired)' NCC=8 (x3 taken) + 'DBcc(cc=False,Count Expired)' NCC=13 (x1, final fall-through) = 8+24+13=45 manual total.

name: seq2_jsr_rts_pair
desc: A genuine call/return: JSR (An) to a real subroutine containing only RTS, then an ADD after the return -- the first real call/return sequence in this corpus (earlier BSR/JSR investigations, Phase 163 Track B, only ever measured the redirect in isolation). CONTROL_INSTR '%JSR' NCC=7 + 'RTS' NCC=14 + ALU 'ADD Rn,Dn' NCC=2 = 23 manual total.

name: seq2_chain4
desc: 4-instruction heterogeneous chain: ADD Rn,Dn(2) / NEG.L(An)(7) / MOVE.L Dn,Dn(2) / SUB Rn,Dn(2). Manual sum=13.

name: seq2_chain6
desc: 6-instruction heterogeneous chain: ADD(2)/AND(2)/NEG.L(An)(7)/ASL#1,Dn(4)/MOVE.L(2)/CLR.L(An)(4). Manual sum=21.

name: seq2_chain8
desc: 8-instruction heterogeneous chain covering the whole register ALU family plus two memory RMW ops. Manual sum=23.

name: seq2_hot_add_x8
desc: 8x unrolled ADD Rn,Dn (register-only steady state, not a loop -- straight-line repetition to see whether the incremental cost found for instruction 2 in the pilot corpus holds flat for instructions 3-8 too, or keeps changing). Manual sum=16.

name: seq2_hot_neg_x4
desc: 4x unrolled NEG.L (An) at 4 distinct addresses (RMW steady state, not a loop -- checks whether bus-contention-limited partial overlap found for the RMW pilot pair holds flat across more repetitions or degrades/improves further). Manual sum=28.
